zh.title: 華航籌集180萬元公益款項捐贈團體 哩程捐贈突破百萬哩
zh.summary: 中華航空籌得180萬元捐贈公益團體；會員哩程捐贈累計突破百萬哩
body: 中華航空宣布攜手員工與華夏會員捐贈哩程回饋社會，共籌得新台幣180萬元款項捐予公益團體。華航於桃園新光影城舉辦愛心公益電影日，由華航資深副總經理李榮輝代表將義賣所得捐贈予家扶基金會、勵馨基金會、睦祥家園及桃園少年之家等單位，投入兒少照顧與弱勢家庭關懷服務。
此外，華航自去年11月推出「會員哩程公益捐贈」專區，提供華夏會員將哩程兌換為捐款。截至今年6月，該專區已吸引近300名會員參與，捐贈總哩程數突破100萬哩，受惠團體包括無國界醫生基金會、看見．齊柏林基金會及親愛音樂文化基金會等。

en.title: China Airlines Donates NT$1.8M to Charities via Staff Sales and Member Miles
en.summary: China Airlines raises NT$1.8 million for charitable groups through staff charity sales and member mileage donations.
body: China Airlines announced that it has raised NT$1.8 million for charitable causes through employee charity sales and member mileage donations. Senior Vice President Li Rong-hui represented the airline at a charity movie event held at Shin Kong Cinema in Taoyuan, presenting sales proceeds to organizations including the Taiwan Fund for Children and Families, The Garden of Hope Foundation, Mu Xiang Children's Home, and Taoyuan Youth Home to support child care and disadvantaged families.

In addition, China Airlines launched a member mileage charity donation initiative in November last year, allowing Dynasty Flyer members to convert mileage into charitable contributions. As of June this year, nearly 300 members have participated, contributing over 1 million miles to recipient organizations such as Doctors Without Borders, Beyond Beauty - Taiwan From Above Inc., and Chin-Ai Music Cultural Foundation.

zh.title: 美國海軍公開AIM-424長程空對空飛彈 支援F-35C內置彈艙掛載
zh.summary: 美國海軍公布AIM-424飛彈；射程超250海浬可內置裝載於F-35C戰機
body: 美國海軍於內華達州里諾（Reno, Nevada）舉行的尾鉤協會（Tailhook Association）年會上，正式發表一款名為「AIM-424 怨恨」（AIM-424 Malice）的全新超長程空對空飛彈。該款飛彈的官方公開射程標示為超過250海浬（約463公里）。美國海軍將AIM-424描述為次世代飛彈，旨在強化艦隊防禦能力，並在面對先進威脅時維持關鍵的空中優勢。
AIM-424飛彈由雷神公司（Raytheon）負責研發，動力系統採用固態火箭發動機。在實體規格與參數方面，該型飛彈的長度為13.5英呎、直徑為13.5英吋，整體重量約為1,500磅。在彈頭配備方面，AIM-424採用破片殺傷式（blast fragmentation）彈頭，以進行長距離空中打擊任務。
隨飛彈公開所發布的官方影像展示了該武器的掛載配置。其中一張影像顯示，來自第23空中測試與評估隊（Air Test and Evaluation Squadron 23）的一架超級大黃蜂（Super Hornet）戰機，在外部掛架上掛載了四枚AIM-424飛彈；另一張照片則顯示兩枚AIM-424飛彈安裝於F-35C戰機的內部彈艙之中。
美國海軍指出，AIM-424飛彈目前正在針對第四代、第五代及第六代航空平台進行開發整合。根據海軍說明，預定支援該型飛彈的戰機平台包括超級大黃蜂戰機、F-35C隱形戰機以及規劃中的F/A-XX未來艦載戰機等機型。

en.title: US Navy Unveils AIM-424 Malice Missile Compatible with F-35C Internal Bay
en.summary: US Navy unveils AIM-424 Malice air-to-air missile with over 250 nautical miles range for F-35C fighters.
body: The US Navy officially unveiled an all-new very long-range air-to-air missile designated as the AIM-424 "Malice" during the Tailhook Association convention held over the weekend in Reno, Nevada. The newly introduced missile system features a published operational range specified as in excess of 250 nautical miles, which translates to approximately 463 kilometers. According to official descriptions provided by the US Navy, the weapon represents a next-generation missile specifically intended to strengthen fleet defense capabilities and maintain a decisive air domain overmatch against advanced threats in modern military operations.

The AIM-424 Malice missile is developed by Raytheon and relies on a solid-propellant rocket motor for its primary propulsion. Official technical dimensions released for the air-to-air weapon list its overall physical measurements at 13.5 feet in total length, 13.5 inches in diameter, and an approximate weight of 1,500 pounds. In terms of destructive payload, the missile is equipped with a blast fragmentation warhead designed for long-range air-to-air engagement scenarios.

Visual documentation released in conjunction with the official unveiling illustrates key carriage configurations for the new missile system. One official image shows an aircraft from Air Test and Evaluation Squadron 23, specifically a Super Hornet, carrying four AIM-424 Malice missiles mounted on external aircraft pylons. Significantly, another released photograph depicts two AIM-424 missiles mounted internally inside the weapons bay of an F-35C fighter, demonstrating internal carriage compatibility on stealth carrier aircraft.

The US Navy confirmed that the AIM-424 long-range air-to-air missile system is currently being developed for deployment across fourth-generation, fifth-generation, and sixth-generation combat aircraft platforms. According to official navy statements, primary target aircraft platforms identified for integration include the F/A-18E/F Super Hornet, the F-35C stealth fighter, and the future F/A-XX aircraft program intended for the carrier air wing of the future.
